about: cmux's rows for regex-after-token.json, in its format, that the pinned copy does not hold yet; each goes to the shared table, and leaves this file when a re-pin brings it.
ranges: TypeScript's parser's, as regex-after-token.json's (the shared table's js-ranges.ts parseAll at the pinned commit, typescript 7.0.2, each source read as a .tsx file).

parsed, family lookahead_literals: a generic arrow (<T extends U>(...) => x) whose lookahead holds a regex, string, template or comment with a //, /*, quote or bracket in it, as a parameter default, a parameter or return type, a constraint or a type parameter default; a statement or an initializer; then a // comment or a call. Sources the parser reports a syntax error in are left out.

rows.why: review of manaflow-ai/cmux#41407 at 2e84a894, F1: the // inside the regex class of a generic arrow's parameter default is regex text, not a comment, so the arrow is one and the // after it is a comment
